labels.C: informed members contest the border terms or refuse the concession, so repair or expansion enforces a side of the dispute
labels.N: the record does not show the clause's parts: the untold keepers, the failed notice, or the loss of the agreed change
labels.M: mistaken repair shown: keepers undid an agreed change because they did not know of it
labels.O: the change undone was not the room's agreed change (a neighbour's overlap, a hostile change, random damage, expansion)
